thread:
maya: quick q on 429 behavior for per-route quotas — are we returning a single global Retry-After or per-route headers? I'm trying to figure out how SDKs should surface this for canary traffic.
ben: short answer: we currently return Retry-After for the immediate request and X-RateLimit-* for the API key overall. But per-route buckets are fuzzy. we discussed a bucket id header earlier.
carla: can you paste the current header set? I want to compare to what clients expect.
ben: sure — current server emits:
```
Retry-After: 12
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 59980
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1672531200
```
No explicit route bucket id.
maya: that's my concern. for routes with small burst windows (e.g., /generate/stream) we sometimes want short 429s but not hammer the whole key. proposal: add X-RateLimit-Bucket: <hex> and X-RateLimit-Scope: route|global. Also include Retry-After-Ms to avoid fractional seconds ambiguity.
leo: +1 for bucket id. Also we should include a structured JSON body for 429 with machine-friendly fields so mobile SDKs can decide backoff strategies without parsing headers.
maya: example body I sketched:
```
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limit_exceeded",
    "message": "Per-route burst limit exceeded",
    "quota_type": "route",
    "bucket_id": "7f3a9c",
    "retry_after_ms": 12000
  }
}
```
ben: I like that. two compatibility notes:
1) older clients expect Retry-After header in seconds — keep it.
2) adding new X-* headers is safe but we should use a stable prefix (X-RW-?). otherwise proxies might strip unknown headers.
carla: about semantics: should a 429 for a route ever imply a global throttle? e.g., if route hits per-route limit but global usage is fine, do we still set X-RateLimit-Remaining to 0 for the key? I think no — keep global remaining accurate.
leo: agree. set headers so that SDKs can pick: if X-RateLimit-Scope=route then the Remaining refers to that bucket, and also emit global headers unchanged.
ops-bot: deploy checklist reminder: add header tests to /eng-runtime/e2e and feature flag to toggle bucket headers. (reminder: run canary in staging first)
maya: one more: what about embeddings/units? those count by cost units not tokens. Need X-Quota-Unit and X-Quota-Unit-Remaining for those endpoints.
ben: yep. semantics:
- For token-based endpoints: X-RateLimit-* as usual.
- For cost-based endpoints: X-Quota-Unit-Limit, X-Quota-Unit-Remaining, X-Quota-Unit-Reset
carla: SDK impact: we'll parse bucket_id and scope, and surface a BackoffPolicy with bucket granularity. can we keep bucket_id stable across deploys? if not, SDKs can't cache it.
ben: bucket id must be stable per route+config for at least N hours (documented) — otherwise it's worthless.
maya: ok action items:
- eng-runtime: add X-RateLimit-Bucket + X-RateLimit-Scope + Retry-After-Ms and structured 429 body (ben)
- eng-platform: update API contract docs and add examples for embeddings cost headers (carla)
- devex/sdk: parse new headers, fallback to Retry-After when structured body absent (leo)
- eng-sre: smoke tests for header presence and proxy passthrough (ops-bot)
ben: assigning PR: i'll open a draft with header names and sample responses.
carla: i'll update the docs PR when draft lands, will ping reviewers.
maya: thanks — can everyone react when PRs are up? quick review will help keep this from slipping.
ben: will do. :thumbsup:
leo: noted.
